extracted.name: Chocolate Butter-Creme Frosting
extracted.description: This simple chocolate buttercream frosting is great on double chocolate cookies.
instruction_lines: In small bowl mix at medium speed, sugar, butter (softened), and salt until light and fluffy.
Add melted chocolate, milk and vanilla extract, beating until well blended.
